body: # A list of authors for the annotation target. Read more in the Metadata Authors section below.
# Options controlling how the annotation target is processed by the Compile API when generating data filters. Read more in the Metadata Compile section below.
# A custom mapping of named parameters holding arbitrary data. Read more in the Metadata Custom section below.
# A description of the annotation target. Read more in the Metadata Description section below.
# Whether or not the annotation target is to be used as a policy entrypoint. Read more in the Metadata Entrypoint section below.
# Arbitrary labels attached to a rule, recorded in decision logs when the rule is evaluated. Read more in the Metadata Labels section below.
# A list of organizations related to the annotation target. Read more in the Metadata Organizations section below.
# A list of URLs pointing to related resources/documentation. Read more in the Metadata Related Resources section below.
# A list of associations between value paths and schema definitions. Read more in the Metadata Schemas section below.
# The scope for which the metadata applies. Read more in the Metadata Scope section below.
# A human-readable name for the annotation target. Read more in the Metadata Title section below.
